# Security Policy / Безопасность

**WinUtil-RU** is maintained independently by [Tokhirjon Yuldoshev](https://github.com/TokhirjonYuldoshev). The original [WinUtil](https://github.com/ChrisTitusTech/winutil) is maintained by Chris Titus Tech and its contributors; upstream vulnerabilities should follow the [original security policy](https://github.com/ChrisTitusTech/winutil/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.md).

## Private vulnerability reports / Конфиденциальные сообщения

For a vulnerability specific to WinUtil-RU (localization, bootstrap, cache or release automation), use **GitHub → Security → Report a vulnerability**, **only if that private reporting control is available**.

**If private reporting is unavailable, this repository does not currently advertise a verified alternate private disclosure channel.** Do **not** publish exploit instructions, credentials, private logs or proof-of-concept secrets in a public Pull Request or other public comment. Ask the maintainer for a private channel using only a contact method they have explicitly made available, or wait until private reporting is enabled. Do not assume that a public PR provides confidentiality.

Для уязвимости, относящейся только к WinUtil-RU, используйте **Security → Report a vulnerability**, если GitHub предоставляет приватную форму. Если её нет, **проверенный альтернативный приватный канал в этом репозитории не указан**. Не публикуйте эксплойты, токены, секреты и личные журналы через публичный PR. Запрашивайте приватный канал только через реально предоставленный владельцем способ связи либо дождитесь включения private vulnerability reporting.

## Ordinary bugs and contributions / Обычные ошибки

**Repository setting verified 10.10.2026:** `Issues = disabled` and `Discussions = disabled` in this fork. Therefore there is currently no enabled public Issue/Discussion form here. Do not direct reporters to an unavailable `/issues` page.

For a non-sensitive, reproducible documentation or code fix, submit a [Pull Request](https://github.com/TokhirjonYuldoshev/WinUtil-RU/pulls) using the [fork contribution rules](CONTRIBUTING.md), targeting `russian`; **do not include secrets or unreviewed diagnostic logs**. A PR is for a proposed change and does not substitute for a confidential security channel. For issues that affect the unmodified original WinUtil backend, use the original project's [issue tracker](https://github.com/ChrisTitusTech/winutil/issues).

**Проверено 10.10.2026:** в данном форке GitHub Issues и Discussions отключены. Для готового безопасного исправления документации или кода создайте [Pull Request](https://github.com/TokhirjonYuldoshev/WinUtil-RU/pulls) по [правилам форка](CONTRIBUTING.md) в `russian`. Не прикладывайте секреты и непроверенные журналы. Для проблем исходного backend используйте [Issues оригинального WinUtil](https://github.com/ChrisTitusTech/winutil/issues).

The fork preserves original upstream attribution and the MIT license.
